progress.empty: The curriculum has no lessons yet.

noScriptorium: The school's Scriptorium was not created.
passwordFirst: Enter your password first — the curricula are sealed.
noChat: The class has no channel or chat yet — create them on the class tab.
noWriter: None of your roles writes in this class.

matrix.noLessons: “{title}” has no lessons yet — add them in “Curricula”.
matrix.noClasses: “{title}” has no classes yet — tick them in “Curricula”.
matrix.label: Delivery of the curriculum “{title}”

class.studentsSay: read the class calendar, channel and page
class.parentsSay: read the class channel and calendar
class.journalSays: Date by date: the topic from the curriculum, whether the lesson took place, a note and homework — also differently for each class.
class.journalNone: Teachers keep the journal in the school's Scriptorium — it doesn't exist yet or you have no access to it.
class.journalLocked: The journal is sealed — enter your password to open it in this tab.
class.programsLocked: The curricula are sealed — enter your password to see them in this tab.
class.programsNone: Curricula are in the school's Scriptorium — the area above the class. It doesn't exist yet or you have no access to it.
class.programOff: The class no longer follows this curriculum.
class.programSays: The curriculum's lessons are topics in the journal; “Spread the curriculum” puts them on the next dates.
class.programChoose: Choose which school curriculum this class follows.
class.noPrograms: The school has no curricula yet — you'll create them on the school tab.
class.programsWriter: Curricula are changed by whoever writes in the school's Scriptorium.
class.addingLesson: Adding the lesson to the timetable…
class.lessonAdded: The lesson is in the timetable.
class.scheduleSays: Weekly lessons are in the class calendar — pupils and parents with a link see them; the journal's dates come from them.
class.rosterReady: The class list is ready — add pupils.
class.studentsSays: A list of pupils with attendance (daily, ticked by the teacher) and notes on pupils that only the teacher sees.
class.rosterFailed: Could not read the class list.
class.linksNote: Pupils added by the teacher have no link of their own. Whoever signs up themselves via the form on the class page gets their own.

journal.distributed: Curriculum spread over the next lessons.
journal.noSlots: There are no further dates — add lessons in “Timetable”.
journal.allPlanned: All lessons of the curriculum are already held or planned.
journal.distribute: Spread the curriculum over the next lessons
journal.slotsFailed: Could not read the timetable — only saved lessons are shown.
journal.empty: There are no lessons in this period. Add a weekly lesson in “Timetable” — or enter an extra lesson.
journal.details: Details — what about the lesson plan
journal.lessonSaved: The lesson is in the journal.
journal.needTopic: Choose a topic or enter a new one.

school.teachersSay: write curricula and class journals; get every new class
school.kindNotSaved: “{name}”: kind “Class” not saved ({error}) — you can set it in the class settings.
school.classesSays: Each class is an area in the school — with a journal, pupils, a timetable and a chat. The school's data controller is responsible for the data: {controller}.
school.noController: there is none yet — set it in the school settings
school.plain: Areas in the school without a kind — maybe these are classes:
school.makeTeachers: Create the role “Teachers” below — every new class will get it right away.
school.teachersAuto: A new class gets the role “Teachers” right away. Pupils, timetable and journal are set up on the class tab.
school.programsSaysNone: You write a curriculum once — for all classes that follow it. It lives in the school's Scriptorium (only its teachers see it): each lesson is a text with a point-by-point plan.
school.programReady: Curriculum “{name}” is ready — add lessons to it.
school.programsSays: You write a curriculum once — for all classes that follow it. Each lesson is a text in the school's Scriptorium: you write its plan (points) there, and the delivery in each class marks what from the plan was done, what briefly, what skipped.
school.addLessonsLabel: Add lessons — one per line (“# Unit” or “Unit:” is a heading)
school.addLessonsPlaceholder:
# Unit I. Creation
God creates the world
Man in the image of God
school.realizationSays: Every lesson of the curriculum in every class: ✓ delivered, ◐ partly, · planned, ✕ didn't take place (to repeat). A click opens the delivery — with notes and what from the plan was done; an empty cell records a new one.
school.realizationEmpty: Once a curriculum has lessons and classes, you'll see here which class is where.
